column1: Nurse administered 10mg of Morphine instead of prescribed 5mg to patient in Room 305. Patient experienced drowsiness but recovered without complications.
Pharmacy dispensed wrong medication - gave Amoxicillin instead of prescribed Augmentin. Error caught by nurse before administration.
Patient fell while attempting to use bathroom unassisted. Sustained minor bruising on left hip, no fractures detected.
Wrong patient almost received blood transfusion - error caught during final ID verification check at bedside.
Surgical count revealed missing sponge before closing. Extended search conducted, sponge located and removed, procedure completed successfully.
